purpose: Keep Heavyster simple as countries, supplier workflows, founder controls, and AI-assisted actions expand.
rule: One screen, one role, one next action.
release_contract: Every primary screen must show one recommended next action before secondary actions.
Every feature must belong clearly to buyer, supplier, or founder work.
Public navigation should stay short; workflow depth belongs in role tools, command search, or contextual next steps.
Every country must reuse the same supplier account, listing, proof, availability, direct enquiry, billing, and admin review objects.
Every AI feature must remove a manual step or clarify a decision before it is allowed into the product.
global_rules: Localize wording, proof labels, and currency display without forking the core product.
Keep the USD listing SaaS anchor until local payment operations are proven.
Do not collect rental payments in phase one.
Launch new countries by supply, proof, availability, response, and listing revenue readiness.
ai_rules: AI may summarize supplier proof, buyer intent, demand signals, and founder action queues.
AI may route users to the next best module only when the reason is visible.
AI may draft enquiries, follow-ups, listing briefs, and founder notes.
AI should not create hidden decisions, unexplained scores, or extra workflows.
AI is accepted only when it removes manual work or makes the next action clearer.
acceptance: Pricing shows the Simple Global UX Guard below the Global Launch Passport.
Build Phase shows the Simple Global UX Guard before the Release Ledger.
Copy UX guard explains the one screen, one role, one next action rule.
Static checks enforce the v135 version, cache tokens, UI hooks, docs, and styling.
monetization_rule: Free profile, USD 9/month or USD 99/year per active listing, 0% rental take in phase one, optional 1% confirmed-booking success fee only after workflow proof.
